verdict.rationale: SigNoz's own docs state that logs can be correlated with traces and metrics for root-cause analysis, and that traces, metrics, and logs live in one platform with span-level trace views. However, no evidence documents a direct jump from a trace span to its logs and metrics; the documented drill-down starts from dashboard panels instead. Missing for 10: explicit span-to-logs navigation, span-to-metrics navigation, details of how trace_id correlation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Correlate logs with traces and metrics for faster root-cause analysis.
SigNoz Cloud brings your traces, metrics, and logs into one OpenTelemetry-native platform.
Follow a single request across all microservices with a flamegraph view that shows every span, its duration, and parent-child relationships.
